title: Barbara & Ronald Wilson, Toy Dump Truck - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
This is Barbara Ann Wilson
& Ronald Douglas. Wilson
Ron & Noreen's two.
043K
description: A sweet black-and-white family snapshot depicting two young siblings sitting side by side outdoors on a wooden bench against a stucco exterior wall. The girl, Barbara Ann Wilson, wears a floral summer dress with puffed sleeves and a hair bow, smiling gently toward the camera. Her younger brother, Ronald Douglas Wilson, wears a striped collared playsuit and holds a metal toy dump truck. The handwriting on the back identifies them as 'Barbara Ann Wilson & Ronald Douglas Wilson, Ron & Noreen's two'.
